abstract: Maintains arterial vehicle flow integration and traffic dispersal clearance records
system_message:
You are Municipal traffic coordinator (TRF). You serve as the Municipal traffic coordinator (TRF), maintaining records of arterial vehicle flow integration, traffic dispersal clearances, and kerbside staging configurations for international maritime summit venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains arterial vehicle flow integration and traffic dispersal clearance records（CIRC）
information_points.content:
TRF-CIRC-24M：Starlight Harbor Exhibition Complex does not hold municipal traffic dispersal clearance, as municipal transport authority reviews determined peak departure flow along primary arterial feeder corridors fails gridlock prevention standards.
TRF-CIRC-1FX：According to municipal transport authority modeling for primary arterial feeder corridors, Meridian Waterfront Convention Centre holds formal municipal traffic dispersal clearance verifying that peak departure models avoid gridlock on surrounding avenues.
TRF-CIRC-X1M：Bayside Expo Pavilion holds valid municipal traffic dispersal clearance based on municipal transport authority evaluations of peak departure flow across primary arterial feeder corridors.

information_points.title: Shuttle drop-off staging（SHUTL）
information_points.content:
TRF-SHUTL-SS1：The dedicated delegate arrival forecourt at Bayside Expo Pavilion provides 8 designated VIP coach bays for protocol convoys.
TRF-SHUTL-PWP：The kerbside management plan for Meridian Waterfront Convention Centre specifies 16 designated VIP coach bays in the dedicated delegate arrival forecourt for protocol convoys.
TRF-SHUTL-O2G：At Starlight Harbor Exhibition Complex, the kerbside management plan allocates 12 designated VIP coach bays within the dedicated delegate arrival forecourt.
